Greensville County, Virginia Tax Sales: A Simple Guide to Getting Started

Are you interested in participating in tax sales in Greensville County, Virginia? This guide will give you a quick and clear overview of how the process works.

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

When Does the Tax Sale Happen?

Greensville County schedules tax sales as needed, and there’s no fixed annual date. Auctions occur when enough properties qualify for sale due to unpaid taxes. Always check our Auction Calendar for scheduled auctions to stay up-to-date.

What Time Does the Auction Begin?

Auction times generally start at 11:00 AM Eastern Time (ET), but the exact time will be confirmed in the auction notice. Always double-check the official announcement for accurate timing.

Is Registration Required?

Yes, you must register in advance to participate in the auction.

When Does Registration Open and Close?

Registration periods vary for each auction. Check the official auction notice for exact registration dates and deadlines. It’s important to review these details early to avoid missing out.

Where Is the Auction Held?

Auctions in Greensville County may be held either online or at a specific physical location. The exact venue will be stated clearly in the auction notice. Make sure to check the location details before the auction day.

Redemption Period Information

Property owners can redeem their properties by paying all overdue taxes, penalties, interest, and other related costs before the auction. After the auction, the redemption option is no longer available.

How Does the Bidding Work?

  • Properties are sold to the highest bidder.
  • A deposit is required immediately after winning the bid.
  • Specific deposit amounts and full payment deadlines will be outlined in the auction notice.
  • All properties are sold “as-is.” It’s important to conduct thorough research and inspections beforehand.

Who Can I Contact for More Information?

For questions or more information, you can reach out to the Greensville County Treasurer’s Office:

  • Phone: (434) 348-4229
  • Website: Greensville County Treasurer’s Office

Stay Updated

To stay informed about upcoming tax sales, regularly visit the Greensville County’s News section for the latest updates.
